name: Source control
description: Branch status, diffs, staging, commits, remote operations, history and conflicts for a worktree.

method.description: A worktree's branch, upstream, changed files by section, the operation in progress and the running remote call.

worktree.description: Worktree selector (id, name, branch, path: or current); defaults to the caller's worktree.

unborn.description: The branch has no commits yet.

entries.description: One row per change, with area, status, line counts and conflict kind; conflicts first.
